scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @fengsui/server" "npm run dev -w @fengsui/web"
scripts.dev:e2e: concurrently -k -n e2e-server,e2e-web -c yellow,cyan "tsx scripts/run-e2e-server.ts" "npm run dev -w @fengsui/web -- --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.build:edgeone: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@fengsui/web -- --mode edgeone
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:web && npm run verify:production
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@fengsui/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@fengsui/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@fengsui/web && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
